paper_title: Thermal Simulation of a CPU Based on Model Order Reduction

evidence.value: Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) with Galerkin projection method
CPU structure with 3D layers including device layer and substrate; floorplan with functional units A, B, and C
3 uniform power pulses applied at functional units A, B, and C; each power source with period of 3.333μs representing average over 10k cycles at 3 GHz
Adiabatic boundary conditions applied to chip surfaces except bottom of substrate where Robin boundary condition is used with ambient temperature of 0°C

POD model with 3 modes provides good accuracy; 5 modes achieve excellent agreement with FEniCS simulation; reduction in numerical degrees of freedom by more than 4 orders of magnitude; temperature evolution shown in Functional unit C and spatial profiles along x and y directions
